notes: 'Thinkest thou' is the ASV's rendering of be'einekha ('in thine eyes'): 'Thinkest' fused on be- + ayin (rules 30, 40) and 'thou' on the 2ms suffix, rather than a supplied matrix on the interrogative particle with the noun and suffix unrepresented.
The interrogative particle takes the 'that' heading the recast embedded question (rule 17); causal ki takes 'in that' whole.
The ASV reorders the second question; the second shalach and its object phrase are aligned by content.
